candidate.definition_en: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
candidate.explanation_ar: شخص فصيح، بيعرف يعبر عن أفكاره بوضوح ولباقة.

senses.definition_en: Able to express thoughts and feelings clearly and effectively.
senses.definition_ar: قادر على التعبير عن أفكاره ومشاعره بوضوح وبلاغة (فصيح أو بليغ).
examples: She is very articulate for her age.
He is an intelligent and articulate speaker.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
She is very articulate for her age.
He is an intelligent and articulate speaker.
The teacher gave an articulate explanation.
candidate.mnemonic: زي 'Article' 'مقال'.. الشخص الـ 'Articulate' بيتكلم بوضوح وترتيب كأنه بيقرا 'Article' مكتوب ببراعة.
